scripts.//prepare: dist/ is gitignored but `main` points at it, so a clean checkout has no runtime entry point. Any consumer that imports a VALUE (not just `import type`, which bundlers erase) then fails to resolve the package. This has now bitten three surfaces: Dockerfile.web (#217), Dockerfile.api (#309), and EAS Build. `prepare` runs on every `pnpm install` in the repo, which fixes it at the source instead of per-consumer.
